This market refers to the Counter-Strike Round 2 match between FORZE Reload and Lavked in the CCT Europe Series #11 Group Stage, initially scheduled for October 16, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET.

This market will resolve to "FORZE Reload" if FORZE Reload wins 2 or more maps than Lavked in this match.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Lavked". 

Maps won by forfeit, disqualification, walkover, or default are counted towards the handicap, provided that the match is completed.

If the match is canceled (not played at all for any reason) or ends in a tie, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match is postponed, it must be rescheduled to a start time on or before October 30, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET (14 calendar days after the originally scheduled start of October 16, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET). If, by that deadline, the most recently announced rescheduled start time is on or before the deadline, this market resolves based on the result of the match as played. Otherwise, this market resolves 50-50, regardless of whether the match is subsequently played.

The match is considered to have begun once live play begins in its first map or game. Warmup rounds and knife rounds do not count as the start of the match. A round forced live because a team did not ready up or resume play within the allotted time does not count as the start of the match if that team forfeits before the next round begins.

If the match begins and one team wins due to the opponent's match forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, the match will count as completed.
